issues.title: Extra TeX backslash before Phi in density caption
issues.quote: Left: 300 complete-law grid checks against the coarse density envelope $\\Phi(M/c)$ from the accepted supervised primary/replication archive.
issues.analysis: The immutable v2 source literally has two backslash characters before Phi (the three preceding code points are dollar36, backslash92, backslash92). This invokes the line-break command followed by letters Phi, rather than the intended Greek macro used in eq:envelope. The numerical plot/data and the density theorem are unaffected. This source-level observation does not assert a failed compilation; the main compiled PDF was not reviewed here.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the doubled backslash before Phi by a single backslash in this caption, leaving the sealed numerical figure and underlying data unchanged.

evidence.quote: For the bosonic, distinguishable and iid multinomial arms, training minimizes the sampled conditional cut plus $2(1-\widehat P_F)$.
A batch with no valid outcome receives the fixed value $\sum_E w_{ij}+3$.
COBYLA uses a 120-call cap, initial radius $0.35$ and tolerance $10^{-7}$; any unspent calls follow a fixed Gaussian local-proposal completion rule of standard deviation $0.1$.
Table~\ref{tab:e05b} and \cref{fig:e05b} show the exact final distribution probabilities after finite-shot training, rather than the noisy success rates in the independent 4096-draw heldout batches.

result.analysis: The selected loss/mu2, W+3 no-valid fallback, penalty sampled energy, COBYLA settings and exact-call completion now agree with the recorded historical driver. The table/figure metric is explicitly the exact selected ideal distribution probability; heldout rates are separate. Fresh read-only parsing of all756 historical records confirms fitted vector lengths12/30/56 versus4/6/8 logits and zero uniform parameters. Photonic count vectors have7/21/71 categories, consistent with CF occupations plus one rejection bucket; the manuscript now expressly says that these traces do not resolve the pair moment M.

evidence.quote: Intervals use 2000 deterministic percentile bootstrap replicates with the $2.5$th and $97.5$th percentiles: a resampled graph cluster contributes all its optimizer repeats and nominal slots, and the replicate mean is the ratio of their summed probabilities to their record count.
Descriptive intervals resample whole graph clusters, retaining optimizer repeats and nominal-slot multiplicities; they are not a population confidence claim for random graph ensembles.

result.analysis: The stated ratio, whole-cluster resampling, percentile level and2000 replicates now match scripts/reconcile_experiments.py:cluster_interval. Nominal weighting is preserved while duplicate graph slots and optimizer repetitions remain inside their unique graph cluster. Counts12 nominal slots versus9/9/10 unique weighted labeled graphs are unchanged. Seed implementation remains reproducible from the pinned code; no population or asymptotic significance claim is added.
